summary: Serge Rielau proposes a new SQL data type, OBJECT, that matches structured fields by name rather than position, addressing the current limitations of STRUCT. Huaxin Gao proposes the first Spark community sync on Nov 30 at 8:30 AM PST, covering recent changes, SPIPs, release status, and an open floor. The SPIP proposal has been updated to address reviewer feedback, adding explicit security guarantees, a dedicated PolicyEnforcement operator, and safeguards against older Spark releases. The discussion asks whether Spark Connect Gateway, which includes cryptographic libraries in its container image, must undergo the ASF export process before its 0.1.0 release.
